guideline: Use background: true to return a Shell Job after startup, and pty: true only when it needs a terminal. timeout limits total runtime; if the command is still running when the foreground wait limit expires, the call returns the Job instead. Use read on the returned output.log with a 1-based line offset to continue from omitted output. Use job_stop to stop the Job, and job_send or job_key for PTY input. Completion is delivered automatically; continue independent work or conclude your turn.
stop: Stop a Shell Job owned by this Agent and report its terminal state.
send: Send literal text to a running PTY Job. Set enter to send Enter after the text; defaults to false.
key: Send one terminal key to a running PTY Job, for example Enter or C-c.
